name: Signature III - Eucalyptus - Obsidian
description: Quiet, with room to spread out. Obsidian outside. Natural eucalyptus inside. Signature III Obsidian gives you a wider bench and a darker room, with the same one-button simplicity the Signature is known for. The exterior is Obsidian, the interior is natural sustainably sourced eucalyptus, the same wood as our Eucalyptus models. Patented SoloCarbon® far infrared heaters surround you with gentle, even heat for a deep cellular sweat, no programs and no learning curve. Bring someone with you, bring two, or take the whole bench and lie back. Chromotherapy lighting and a premium Bluetooth sound system are there when you want them. Supports detoxification through deep sweating, circulation, immune health, and relaxation.
